_comment: §12 S1 real-failure fixture — banked as T3 regression corpus (AC-65.3)
description: Sell tx reverted with Anchor error 6023 (NotEnoughTokensToSell). Root cause: the sell instruction encoded the buy-time entry_tokens estimate but the wallet held fewer tokens (Token-2022 transfer fee deducted on buy receipt, or tokens partially transferred). Fix: always query live ATA balance before building the sell ix, not the stored entry_tokens estimate.
notes: 6023 storms are a benign confirmation-race when the live ATA balance was checked but a prior partial sell already cleared some tokens. Retry with fresh balance query. Not a slippage issue — do not widen the slippage tier.
